EraseMode.description: What an erase does with the person's content.

oneOf.description: Messages, reactions and files stay, attributed to "Deleted user".
The person's messages are tombstoned and purged, reactions removed, uploads deleted.

dry_run.description: Count only: the same answer, computed without writing anything.

external_id.description: Whose account to erase. Never `link:` or `erased:`.

mode.description:
What happens to the person's content. Absent: [`EraseMode::default_for`] the id (for an
erasure already made, the mode it ran with). The answer echoes the mode that ran.
